answer: Neighborhood overlap threshold requires a new agent’s counterpart graph to overlap at least a third with three separate existing neighborhoods. A river of fresh links from one cluster still fails because those counterparts lack prior cross-neighborhood paths. To fake breadth, each added identity must cultivate distinct organic counterparties, a violet detour that costs months and exposes reputation. Every clone also needs its own quill of genuine correspondence across unrelated neighborhoods, so attacker cost scales with real relationships rather than signatures.
